PRINCIPLE: Assertions should verify multiple relevant properties. EVALUATION: test6 only asserts that imprime() throws a NullPointerException (single assertion/expectation). DECISION: Only one behavioral check present; no multiple property verification. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Avoid @Ignore/@Disabled or commented-out tests. EVALUATION: No @Ignore/@Disabled annotations or commented-out @Test are present in the provided snippet. DECISION: tests are active. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Link tests to requirements. EVALUATION: Class-level Javadoc includes 'Traceability: REQ-DS-1', which provides requirement linkage. DECISION: traceability info found in Javadoc. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Performance/security tests are separate. EVALUATION: This is a unit test without timing/security checks; no @Test(timeout=...) used for performance analysis beyond EvoSuite's normal timeout. DECISION: unit test context -> mark not-applicable unless explicit perf/security tests are present. VERDICT: not-applicable.

PRINCIPLE: Test names should be descriptive. EVALUATION: Method name 'test6' is generic and auto-generated, giving no scenario/result information. DECISION: generic naming -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Avoid heavy autogenerated artifacts. EVALUATION: File header states 'automatically generated by EvoSuite' and method name is auto-generated (test6), indicating significant code generation. DECISION: presence of generator comment and auto-generated naming -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should show thoughtful design (Given-When-Then or BDD naming). EVALUATION: test6 is minimal and auto-generated; no Given-When-Then structure, limited scenario design. DECISION: minimal single-case autogenerated test -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should interact via public APIs and avoid peeking into internals. EVALUATION: test6 only uses public methods of TabelaHash and no reflection or private-field access is present. DECISION: No evidence of brittle internal coupling. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Assertions should be specific and include messages where helpful. EVALUATION: The test uses fail(...) and verifyException(...) but contains no descriptive assertion messages and performs essentially a single behavioral check. DECISION: Lack of descriptive messages and limited assertion coverage -> non-compliant. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Comments should explain 'why' not 'what' and avoid commented-out code. EVALUATION: test6 contains minor comments generated by EvoSuite but no commented-out test code or excessive commentary. DECISION: no commented-out code and comments are minimal. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must avoid non-determinism. EVALUATION: test6 contains no use of Random(), current time, Thread.sleep(), or external dependencies in the snippet. DECISION: no non-deterministic sources detected. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should not leave persistent side effects. EVALUATION: test6 creates a local TabelaHash and does not perform file/database operations or modify static state. DECISION: no persistent side effects or missing cleanup observed. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Use labels/categories to organize tests. EVALUATION: The class is annotated with @Category(UnitTest.class), providing classification. DECISION: annotation present and meaningful. VERDICT: compliant.
